description: This file implements a splay tree data structure with size maintenance features, based on top-down splaying algorithms. It includes functions for splaying, inserting, and deleting nodes, and references external algorithms and data structures related to splay trees.

methods.name: splaytree_splay_nonnull
methods.description: Performs top-down splaying on the tree for a given key, bringing the key or the last accessed node to the root.

methods.name: splay_tree * splaytree_insert_splayed(splay_tree * t,int i,void * data)
methods.description: Inserts a new node into the splayed tree, assuming the tree is already splayed on the key.

methods.name: splay_tree * splaytree_insert(splay_tree * t,int i,void * data)
methods.description: Inserts a key and associated data into the splay tree if not already present; performs splaying as needed.

methods.name: splaytree_delete_splayed_node
methods.description: Deletes the currently splayed node at the root of the tree, returning the resulting tree.

methods.name: splay_tree * splaytree_delete(splay_tree * t,int i)
methods.description: Deletes a node with a specific key from the splay tree if present.
